subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a core config surface now, and should `full` be the only tier that admits hook-loaded extra bootstrap files?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but choosing this config/default surface affects prompt context, session behavior, hook semantics, and upgrade expectations in a way automation should not decide.

options.title: Sponsor this PR shape
options.body: Proceed with maintainer review after a rebase, requiring unchanged no-override behavior plus docs/tests for resolver, hook extras, schema/help, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Fold into broader selector design
options.body: Pause this PR behind a broader bootstrap/session selector contract that covers related deterministic context proposals.

options.title: Decline the new knob
options.body: Keep fixed session filters and steer users to existing context budgets, contextInjection, lightweight mode, and hook/plugin surfaces instead.
